reason: 该插件面向用户的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 自动化生成并展示“梦境”式会话摘要：它监听会话事件流、按配置触发生成流程，并通过命令与 Web 页面展示结果与状态。依据 README 的命令、事件处理、配置项、路由与本地持久化设计，该功能可归为自动化类插件并带有数据/界面可视化交互能力，同时涉及模型调用与本地记录管理。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可在后台自动汇总会话内容与工具事件生成梦境风格摘要，并通过 `/dreams` 页面与命令供用户查看与管理。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically summarizes session activity into dream-style reports in the background and lets users view or manage them through the `/dreams` page and related commands.

capabilities: Consumes session event streams in the background to build dream reports
Generates text via configured LLM model routes
Exposes web routes and SSE endpoints for viewing and updating dream records
Provides session commands for forcing dream generation, listing recent dreams, and viewing settings
Persists dream ledger data to a local JSON file with configurable path and retention limits

reasons.code: Asynchronous background digesting of conversation and tool logs is the plugin’s core workflow
Web UI and HTTP API endpoints (`/dreams`, `/dreams/api/*`, `/dreams/api/stream`) indicate local service exposure and live event streaming
Feature set depends on configured model/provider route and includes privacyMode controls for prompt input handling
Local persistence uses a ledger file path (`storePath`) and caps stored records, implying file I/O and retention behavior
Plugin is packaged for the DeepSeek Harness DSH plugin ecosystem, using DSH command and session/LLM integrations
